{{Top|leg}}
'''Solo Agents''' were specialized members of [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]]. They were clandestine [[operative]]s skilled in espionage, covert intelligence gathering, extraction or execution of security threats, and a myriad of other mission assignments. Solo Agents were trained to work alone and complete their mission objectives without assistance from [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] authorities. Solo Agents also underwent specialized training, as well as having their skills enhanced through the use of [[mnemiotic drug]]s.
